name: zgeometry_model_add_polygon_to_di
description: zGeometry_Model::AddPolygonToDi rejects undersized polygons, optionally creates a debug material when both UVs and material are missing, clears the local tag, and forwards the polygon to zDi::AddPolygon.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zGeometry/zModel source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x46a770 validates local zTag4 clear, point-count rejection below 3, debug material creation when uvPairs and material are both null, and the zDi::AddPolygon call with zeroed optional normal/secondary UV arguments and the local user tag.

The native zGeometry model smoke verifies undersized polygon rejection and the successful material-supplied forwarding path through zDi::AddPolygon, including entry count, vertex count, entry material, and cleanup through zDi::FreeContents.
